name: update_calendar_preferences
description:
Update calendar preferences for a single calendar in Sunsama.
STATE-CHANGING — REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER CONFIRMATION. Note the mismatch before using it: the input takes only `calendarId`, so which preferences change and what they change to are decided by Sunsama, not by this call, and nothing in the request or response tells you what the values were before or what they became. You therefore cannot describe the outcome to the user in advance. Read the calendar's current preferences first, name the calendar to the user by its title rather than its id, say plainly that the specific settings are not visible from this tool, and get explicit approval. Do not call it to discover what it does, and do not infer a preference change from a vague instruction — ask.

calendarId.description: The calendar ID to update preferences for
